description: This file defines the EmailSubscriberSearchFilterParams class, which extends FilterParams and provides filtering options (such as enabled status and IDs) for searching email subscribers within the OrangeHRM system. It includes class constants, properties, constructor, and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: EmailSubscriberSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object that encapsulates search filter parameters for email subscribers, including allowed sort fields, enabled status, and IDs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters object, setting the default sort field.

methods.name: getEnabled
methods.description: Returns the enabled status filter value.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Sets the enabled status filter value.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Returns the list of IDs used for filtering.

methods.name: setIds
methods.description: Sets the list of IDs for filtering.
